items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Get from a C.A.M.P. Brewing Vat or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Build a Generator in a C.A.M.P. or Workshop
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu, navigate to Power and place any Generator.

items.title: Collect Pre-War Money
items.detail: Check Shredders, cash registers, and safes at Camden Park or Wavy Willard's Water Park.

items.title: Collect a Plunger
items.detail: Search Whitespring Resort maintenance building or Wavy Willard's Water Park restrooms.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and enter the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Kill a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center for reliable spawns.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with any Energy Weapon
items.detail: Any energy weapon counts; Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center has reliable robot spawns.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors for fastest completion.

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Five to eight gnomes stand in the walled garden at The General's Steakhouse in the Mire.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance five times.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town Bounty Board, then track and eliminate the assigned Outlaw enemy.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; energy weapons work best.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from the wild or plant vegetables at your C.A.M.P. for on-demand gathering.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume outfit; phantoms appear at cabins, campgrounds, and fairgrounds.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park has reliable spawns of about a dozen Scorched.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it for fastest completion.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies with Halloween-themed rewards and candy bowl challenges.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish with new local legend, recipes and challenges available.
